tool_calls.input:
const r = await tools.exec_command({"cmd":"python3 -B -c '
import hashlib,json,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from tools.i18nlib.config import load_manifest
from tools.i18nlib.locale_model import LocaleLoader
from tools.i18nlib.runtime import LuaRuntime
manifest=load_manifest()
loader=LocaleLoader(LuaRuntime(manifest))
base_bytes=subprocess.check_output(["git","show","HEAD:tome-orcs.lua"])
cur_bytes=Path("tome-orcs.lua").read_bytes()
base=loader.load_bytes(base_bytes,logical_path="HEAD:tome-orcs.lua").translations
cur=loader.load_bytes(cur_bytes,logical_path="tome-orcs.lua").translations
assert len(base)==len(cur), (len(base),len(cur))
immutable=("kind","source","source_tag","args_order","special")
immutable_changes=[]
changed=[]
for i,(a,b) in enumerate(zip(base,cur)):
    delta=[k for k in immutable if a.get(k)!=b.get(k)]
    if delta: immutable_changes.append((i,delta))
    if a.get("target")!=b.get("target"): changed.append((i,a,b))
ws=json.loads(Path(".ai/task/repair-w41-20260927/WORKSET.json").read_text())
expected={(x["source"],x.get("source_tag"),x["target_preimage_sha256"]):x["entry_revision_identity"] for x in ws["items"]}
seen=[]
for _,a,b in changed:
    key=(a["source"],a.get("source_tag"),hashlib.sha256(a["target"].encode()).hexdigest())
    assert key in expected, ("changed target outside WORKSET",a["source"][:80])
    seen.append(expected[key])
assert not immutable_changes, immutable_changes
assert len(changed)==22, len(changed)
assert len(seen)==len(set(seen))==len(expected)==22
assert set(seen)==set(expected.values())
print(f"LuaJIT bounded diff PASS: base_records={len(base)} current_records={len(cur)} changed_targets={len(changed)} immutable_record_changes={len(immutable_changes)} workset_matches={len(seen)}")
'","workdir":"/workspace/tome4-chinese-translation","yield_time_ms":30000,"max_output_tokens":10000,"sandbox_permissions":"require_escalated","justification":"是否允许运行冻结范围内的 LuaJIT LocaleLoader 比较，验证相对 HEAD 恰有 22 条 WORKSET target 改动且其他记录字段不变？"});
text(r.output);
